messages:
Kira Valdez: hey all! kira here — excited to join eng-platform as an infra engineer. based in berlin, starting today. small pottery nerd + big coffee person + amateur empanada baker. desk 3B. any tips for plant watering or office rituals? :wave: :seedling:
Sam (Recruiter): welcome kira!! :tada: so happy you're here. empanadas?? yes pls. i'll DM you about paperwork and slack access. desk 3B is great — you're next to the fern watering station, people usually water Tue/Thu.
Marcos: welcome!! bring empanadas to lunch when you can and i'll bring hot sauce. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Olivia: hey Kira — quick FYI we keep a shared watering rota in #office and a small supply kit under the kitchen sink (plant food + spray bottle). also, there's a tiny ceramics club that meets Wednesdays after work if you're into that. :herb:
Onboard-bot: Welcome Kira! Useful links: Onboarding checklist — https://redwood.internal/onboarding, Office norms — https://redwood.internal/handbook/office, Slack intro thread template — /intros
Kira Valdez: awesome, thanks everyone! quick Q — is there a preferred coffee setup? i'm a pour-over fan but don't want to haul gear. and where's the bike storage?
Ben (Facilities): we have a Moccamaster + french press in the kitchen, beans in labeled bins (help yourself). bike room is in B2 — ping facilities and we'll add you to the access list.
Lena: welcome Kira! if you want a plant buddy i'm on the rota and happy to add you — saves a soggy pothos. :seedling:
Kira Valdez: please add me, yes! also—i'm planning to bring empanadas this Friday (vegan option too). who's in?
Olivia: count me in :raised_hands:
Sam (Recruiter): i'm in. also dmed you about today's 2pm onboarding sync and the badge pickup. welcome again, Kira ❤️
Kira Valdez: thanks everyone — feeling very welcome already. see you around and will post a Friday reminder for the empanadas. :)
